transaction.issue_identity: Keep all consistent associations of observed Bank/address to accepted tokens; repeated IDs are not identities.
transaction.on_limit: INCOMPLETE; do not choose or silently discard hypotheses
transaction.response_order: AR acceptance order within each source
transaction.response_latency: MEM capture edge or later; no exact scheduling or maximum deadline asserted
not_checked: pending update timing and exact count
five-entry issue window and exact retry/refill cycle

rules.P_KNOWN_FRAME: Preserve four-state values; reject unknown active inputs/control/status and valid payload.
rules.T_R_HAS_PENDING: Each observed R handshake belongs to an accepted, not-yet-returned source head.
rules.T_R_ID_ORDER: RID equals the head's accepted ARID; validate even when IDs repeat.
rules.T_R_PORT_ORDER: Return port equals the same source head's AR port.
rules.T_R_ADDR_ORDER: Return low address equals the same source head's AR low address.
rules.T_R_DATA_RESP_OR_EARLY: At least one complete global issue association must match the head's MEM data and error priority at each R.
rules.T_CAPACITY: At most nine accepted outstanding transactions, including simultaneous return/accept.
rules.T_REQ_HAS_ACCEPTED: Each visible request matches a not-yet-issued accepted request in a consistent global association.

strict.pending_timing: combinational lookahead including current AR accept and issue success
strict.validation: Full native SVA plus input audit; no learning or per-cycle latency matching.

fatal_policy.off: Archive every failure and $error; final run/regression FAIL; exclude its coverage.

sampling: Complete pre-edge #1step frames. Registered consumer, explicit final flush, asynchronous reset epochs. Native SVA retains its own Preponed sampling and sampled failure operands.
